picks.title: Introducing Instant Soundtracks
picks.rationale: This is a new ElevenLabs release: upload a video and it writes an original score and places SFX as separate, editable timeline layers, across ElevenCreative, ElevenMusic and the API. It changes how sound for video gets roughed in.
picks.excerpt: ElevenLabs launched Instant Soundtracks in ElevenCreative, ElevenMusic and the API: upload a video and the model scores it with original music, then detects moments that need sound effects and places them on the timeline as separately editable layers; existing audio can be used as a reference for genre, tempo or instrumentation.

picks.title: Zoom Neurig: a $300 touchscreen amp modeler with NAM capture support and AI stem separation
picks.rationale: Zoom is bringing Neural Amp Modeler profiles and on-device AI stem separation to a $300 multi-effects unit. That puts ML-based tone capture into budget hardware.
picks.excerpt: Is this affordable do-it-all multi-effects from Zoom about to shake up the modeler market?

picks.title: Rocketship maps a song's likely listeners before release, for free
picks.rationale: A newly launched free tool uses AI to identify a track's target audience before release. Indie artists get pre-release targeting data they could not get before without a label.
picks.excerpt: Rocketship gives indie artists major-label level data, using AI to identify target audiences for songs before release or spending a dime.

picks.title: Neko Pocket Studio: a pocket wireless guitar workstation with NAM tones, stem separation and audio-to-tab
picks.rationale: A new device packs NAM playback, recording, stem separation, generative AI features and audio-to-tab transcription into one portable unit for practice and tracking.
picks.excerpt: The Neko packs NAM tones, recording, stem separation, GenAI features, wireless connectivity, and audio-to-tab features into one tiny powerhouse

picks.title: MIDI-REPA: aligning text-to-music models with symbolic MIDI structure
picks.rationale: This paper aligns text-to-music audio models with MIDI derived from automatic transcription, a cheaper route to better melody, rhythm and harmony than scaling compute. It was held in reserve on 10-18.
picks.excerpt: State-of-the-art text-to-music models increasingly rely on scaling model capacity, data, and compute, while still learning musical structure directly from dense audio. Yet melody, rhythm, harmony, and structure can be represented compactly in symbolic form. We introduce MIDI-REPA, a representation-alignment framework that derives MIDI supervision from automatic music transcript

dedup.note: SIGNAL-CHAIN CHECK: Zoom Neurig and Neko Pocket Studio were each compared with the 09-27 Melofty Axom Max card and the 10-18 Line 6 Helix Stadium 1.4 card.
